info.title: TropMail API
info.description:
Private inbound email API for TropMail.

Create addresses that only receive mail. List, search, read, and update messages; scan and download attachments. Official SDKs and MCP use the same contract.

## Base URL
- **Production**: `https://api.tropmail.com/api/v1`

## Authentication
API keys from the TropMail dashboard (Pro and above). Keys are 32 alphanumeric characters, optionally prefixed with `tm_live_`. Send `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`.

## Rate limiting
Per **account** by plan (Pro 3 / Ultimate 10 / Enterprise 50 requests per second) — not per mailbox or per key. Headers: `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset`. On **429**, honor `Retry-After`.

## Response envelope
JSON responses use `{success,message,data,error}`. `success` is `true` and `error` is `null` on 200; on errors `success` is `false`, `data` is `null`, and `message`/`error` explain what happened. Correlate with `X-Request-ID`.

MCP tools receive the unwrapped `data` object, not this envelope. Attachment **download** routes return raw bytes, not JSON.

tags.name: Mailbox
tags.description: List inboxes at `GET /mailboxes`. Mail, search, and attachments use `/mailbox/{id}/…`.

tags.name: Emails
tags.description: Email listing, details, and status updates

BearerAuth.description: TropMail API key from the dashboard. Send `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`. Required on every `/api/v1/*` route except `GET /health`.

StandardResponse.description: Standard JSON envelope. On success `error` is `null` and `data` holds the payload. On failure `success` is false, `data` is `null`, and `message` / `error` explain the problem.

data.description: The actual payload for successful responses, or `null` on errors.

error.description: Error message string if `success` is false.

action_status.description: Favorite, Block, Phishing, Scam, Malicious, or null

status.description: Convenience field for UI. If `action_status` is set, matches that; otherwise matches `email_state`.

content.description: Body content in the requested view (text/html/markdown).

parts.description: Optional extras from inbound (unsubscribe, calendar, inline images). Omitted when empty.

EmailParts.description: Optional MIME extras written when the message arrived.

path.description: R2 object key for the .ics file.

inlineCids.description: Content-ID → attachment_id. Use to resolve cid: images.

size.description: Size in bytes. `0` is a real empty file and can be downloaded.

scan_status.description: Whether the file has been scanned. After you start a scan this is `Processing` until the result is ready.

scan_result.description: Shaped scan report when a scan has completed (or failed).

ScanReport.description: Malware scan report for an attachment (engine summaries and optional file hashes).

error.description: Machine-readable failure code when the scan could not complete

MailboxList.description: Inboxes this API key may see. An empty array means this key has no inboxes yet.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Error envelope. `success` is false; `data` is null.

message.description: Human-readable summary for UI toasts and logs.

error.description: Error detail string when `success` is false.

BadRequest.description: Invalid request — missing search `query`, malformed UUID, or `limit`/`page` out of range. Envelope with `success: false`.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, malformed, or unknown Bearer API key. Envelope with `success: false`.

Forbidden.description: Plan cannot use the API (Basic/guest) or this key cannot access the mailbox. Envelope with `success: false`.

example.message: API access requires Pro or above

NotFound.description: Mailbox, email, or attachment UUID unknown or out of this key’s scope. Envelope with `success: false`.

RateLimited.description: Account rate limit exceeded (Pro 3/s, Ultimate 10/s, Enterprise 50/s — per account, not per mailbox). Honor `Retry-After` and `X-RateLimit-*`.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests per second allowed for this account.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp when the current window resets.

AttachmentUnavailable.description: Attachment exists but has no stored object (empty path). A file whose `size` is `0` is still downloadable.

get.description: Service status check. Returns service version and timestamp. **No authentication required.**

post.description:
Update `email_state` (Open/Close) or `action_status` (Favorite, Delete, Block, etc.).

- Provide **at least one** field in the body.
- Optional `timestamp` (RFC3339) from list/detail speeds up the update.
- `Block` marks the message and blocks that sender from future delivery to the mailbox.
- To clear `action_status`, send an empty string `""` (also unblocks the sender if it was Blocked).

action_status.description: Apply action. Empty string clears status.

timestamp.description: Optional email timestamp from list/detail (speeds up lookup)

Retrieve email details with content rendered in a specific format (`text`, `html`, `markdown`).

For `markdown`: returns markdown immediately when already available. If not, this request waits until conversion finishes (up to about 60 seconds). Timeout is 504; retry the same GET.

post.description:
Start a malware scan for an attachment.

The response is immediate. A new scan comes back as `Processing`, and `scan_result` is empty until the scan completes (usually 1–2 minutes). Keep reading `GET /mailbox/{id}/attachments/{attId}` until `scan_status` is `Clean`, `Malicious`, `Suspicious`, or `Unknown`.

- Already `Processing`: success, the scan is still running.
- `NotScanned`: starts the scan and returns `Processing`.
- Already finished: returns the existing status. The file is not scanned again.
- `Processing` for more than 30 minutes: calling scan again starts a new scan.

200.description: Scan initiated or already in progress

x-sourcey-code-samples.source:
curl -sS -X POST 'https://api.tropmail.com/api/v1/mailbox/11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111/attachments/660e8400-e29b-41d4-a716-446655440002/scan' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TROPMAIL_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'

x-sourcey-code-samples.label: TypeScript
Python
x-sourcey-code-samples.source:
from tropmail import TropMail
import time

with TropMail() as client:
    mailbox_id = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
    att_id = "660e8400-e29b-41d4-a716-446655440002"
    client.attachments.scan(mailbox_id, att_id)
    info = client.attachments.get(mailbox_id, att_id)
    while info.scan_status == "Processing":
        time.sleep(2)
        info = client.attachments.get(mailbox_id, att_id)
    print(info.scan_status)
